quotes.excerpt: The Spurs remain committed to De'Aaron Fox and believe they wouldn't have made the Finals without him

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: The Spurs remain committed to De'Aaron Fox and believe they wouldn't have made the Finals without him last season. After Fox's rough showing in the NBA Finals, team sources said the Spurs remain committed to the veteran, pointing out that San Antonio might have never reached the Finals without the point guard's contributions while playing on a high right ankle sprain.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: So are we getting rid of Fox because he had a bad series?

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: No, his team got to the Finals, but he was a pivotal reason why they lost. He was bad in the Finals.
